verdict.rationale: Poly has no dedicated export feature, but its own sync folder and CLI let users get their files out to local disk in their native formats. Pinning a folder downloads everything inside it, `poly cp` copies from Poly to local disk, Finder tags sync with Poly tags, and journal entries are stored as Markdown. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all account data (including Mind memories and version history), explicit open-format guarantees for non-file data, an account-deletion/offboarding flow, and independent corroboration.
